items.name: b12418
items.body:
<details open>

ggml-cpu: add x86 VNNI Q2_0 dot product (#26348)

* ggml-cpu: use VNNI for Q2_0 dot products

Keep the upstream AVX2 unpacking, accumulation, and fallback. Use VNNI for the integer dot product on supported x86 CPUs.

Assisted-by: Codex

* ggml-cpu: use VBMI for Q2_0 unpacking

Use multishift to unpack Q2_0 weights on CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI and VL. Retain the existing shift-and-mask unpacking on other CPUs.

Assisted-by: Codex

* Update ggml/src/ggml-cpu/arch/x86/quants.c
